item.title: Reverse-engineering Samsung Notes handwriting
item.description: I'd been moving off Samsung Notes and wanted to take my handwritten notes with me, except there's no real way to get them out. You can export a page as an image or a PDF, but that's a flat picture, the actual strokes stay locked in the app. The file Samsung Notes saves, .sdocx, is a ZIP, but everything inside is an undocumented binary format. I started on it in October 2025, and my decoder and a small renderer for it are on GitHub. Almost all the work went into one piece of it, how a single pen stroke is stored. That's also where the other tool that reads this format gets the encoding wrong.
